Annotation Interface MicronautChaosTest

@Target(TYPE) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Documented @Inherited @ExtendWith(ChaosMicronautExtension.class) @Property(name="macstab.chaos.test.enabled", value="true") public @interface MicronautChaosTest
Meta-annotation combining MicronautTest and the ChaosMicronautExtension so that a test class opts into chaos instrumentation with a single annotation.

Each annotated class gets a class-scoped ChaosSession opened once before the first test and closed after the last one. The session can be injected as a test method parameter. The context's ChaosControlPlane bean tracks what it activates; the macstab.chaos.test.enabled property set here selects that bean. A test that composes @MicronautTest and @ExtendWith(ChaosMicronautExtension.class) itself adds @Property(name = "macstab.chaos.test.enabled", value = "true") for it. 

@MicronautChaosTest
class OrderServiceChaosTest {
    @Test
    void slowDatabaseRejectsOrdersGracefully(ChaosSession chaos) {
        chaos.activate(...);
    }
}
